explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1164, which says Révész and Kesten conjectured, and Dembo–Peres–Rosen–Zeitouni proved, a limit law for (log R_n)²/log n (the page displays it as lim P((log R_n)²/log n ≤ x) = e^{−4x}). The Lean statement is the DPRZ theorem in its cover-time form [DPRZ04, Thm 1.4]: for t > 0, P(the walk has covered the open lattice disc of radius n by time ⌊exp(t (log n)²)⌋) → e^{−4/t}, which is lim P(log T_n ≤ t(log n)²) = e^{−4/t} since T_n is an integer. This is the same result expressed through the cover time T_n of the disc of radius n rather than through R_n, with the disc convention (‖x‖ < n) taken from the paper. Faithful to the cited theorem.
